statement: Publishing dist/Axo.app never exposes a partially copied bundle or follows a symlinked destination: an existing directory is exchanged atomically so the previous bundle remains available for rollback, and a new destination is created exclusively to reject a concurrent replacement.
consequence: A failed or concurrent package operation must not leave a partially installed app or overwrite an unexpected filesystem target.

enforcedAt.trigger: The validated staged app is moved to dist/Axo.app
